reason: As this retired Ridgeview homeowner on a fixed income, I'd find A more persuasive. It speaks to my fixed income directly and honestly ("I won't tell you $10 a month is nothing"), answers the "blank check" letter with the exact rate, the end date and the two things the money pays for, and gives the correct Ridgeview cost of about $122 a year. B is also accurate, but it has nothing for someone on a fixed income and spends part of its short time on renters and costs for other neighbourhoods, which don't apply to me.
